role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy with persistent thesis invalidation, strategy and company risk, committee capital authorization, explicit direction/selection/roll attribution, and capacity-constrained weekly execution.
invariants: thesis evaluation uses only the prior published forecast and the newly realized settlement market
configured research capability scores never enter thesis invalidation or recovery
an invalidated thesis can reduce risk but cannot enlarge same-direction exposure
a material signal reversal exits an existing prior-direction position before opening the reverse direction
strategy risk runs after thesis adjustment and before company risk
direction carry plus contract selection equals named-contract carry pnl
roll and directional rebalance attribution partition net-adjustment pnl and cost without changing account pnl
all roll transfers are matched between legacy exits and same-direction destination openings
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
the strategy never changes public prices, market volume, open interest, forecasts or macro rows
